cues: Use this one formula always, and fix the signs with one question: does this motion bring them closer?
An observer moving towards the source has positive v o; moving away, negative.
A source moving towards the observer has positive v s; moving away, negative.
And check: any approach must raise the frequency.
If your answer says otherwise, a sign is wrong.
